text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializeInTranslating(x, y) ::: x specializes in translating y.
Language(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
Published(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ ∀x (Published(x, newVesselPress) → Language(x, english)) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English. All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Published(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ∧ TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press and was translated from Italian.
Published(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
¬Published(harryPotter, newVesselPress) ::: Harry Potter was published by New Vessel Press.
